newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY APV CONFIRMS BALATON FUSZERT SALE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY APV CONFIRMS BALATON FUSZERT SALE.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV confirmed on Monday a news agency report that it had decided to sell a 50 percent plus one vote stake in food wholesaler and retailer Balaton Fuszert .
"The sale has been decided," APV spokesman Adam Dudits told Reuters.
However, he added that the stake would be sold to one consortium and not two investors as the Hungarian MTI-ECONEWS economic news agency said earlier on Monday.
"There is only one investor, a consortium," Dudits said.
The consortium is made up of Balaton Invest 96 Kft and Dunantuli Befektetesi Consortium, he added.
MTI-ECONEWS said that Balaton Invest 96 was owned by the managements of Budapest Fuszert and the holding company Csopak, while Dunantuli Befektetesi was made up of Hungarian food industry companies.
